items.name: pointing-bubble
items.title: Pointing Bubble
items.description: A Vue 3 callout whose tail points exactly at a coordinate or a DOM element.
items.author: Alexey Murz Korepov
items.docs: Import it from `@/components/ui/pointing-bubble`. The bubble fills its nearest positioned ancestor; coordinates are measured from that ancestor. Full guide: https://murznn.github.io/vue-pointing-bubble/
